description.zh: 域名名称。可通过调用[DescribeDomains ](~~2357286~~)获取
description.en: The domain name. Call [DescribeDomains](~~2357286~~) to obtain the domain name.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认值：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en.

description.zh:
是否返回域名详细的属性，取值范围：
- true：
- false 

默认值：false，不需要细节属性。

当值为**true**时，则返回以下数据：lineType、minTtl、recordLineTreeJson、recordLines、lineCode、lineDisplayName、lineName、regionLines、slaveDns。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return detailed attributes of the domain name. Valid values:

- true

- false

The default value is false.

If you set this parameter to **true**, the response includes the following parameters: lineType, minTtl, recordLineTreeJson, recordLines, lineCode, lineDisplayName, lineName, regionLines, and slaveDns.

descriptions.zh: 本示例中域名绑定的实例为企业旗舰版。线路枚举信息可以参考RecordLines的返回值。
descriptions.en: In this example, the domain name is bound to an instance of Alibaba Cloud DNS Ultimate Edition. For more information about line enumeration, see the RecordLines response parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-domain-info --lang en --domain-name example.com --need-detail-attributes true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeDomainInfo --region cn-hangzhou --NeedDetailAttributes true --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en
